Generate a pull request title, a detailed description, and a list of labels for the following change.

PR CONTEXT:
- PR number: __PR_NUMBER__
- Base branch: __BASE_BRANCH__
- Head branch: __HEAD_BRANCH__
- Author: __AUTHOR__
- Current title: __CURRENT_TITLE__
- Current description (may be empty): __CURRENT_BODY__

CHANGED FILES (__FILE_COUNT__):
__CHANGED_FILES__

CODE DIFF (added and removed lines, up to 2000 chars):
__DIFF_CONTENT__

REQUIRED OUTPUT FORMAT (strictly):

TITLE: <conventional-commit-type>(<scope>): <subject>

- <bullet 1>
- <bullet 2>
- <bullet 3>
- <bullet 4> (optional)
- <bullet 5> (optional)

LABELS: <label1>, <label2>, <label3>

RULES:
- TITLE: starts with feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore, perf, ci, build, or revert
- TITLE: max 72 chars total
- Description: 3-5 bullets, each starts with "- "
- Wrap each bullet at 72 chars per line
- Each bullet explains one concrete change: what was modified and why
- Be specific: name functions, files, or behaviors
- Focus on intent, not mechanics

LABELS RULES:
- Output 1-4 labels total, comma-separated, lowercase, no spaces
- Each label must be one of the conventional types below (prefer the first
  one that fits; add a scope label as a second if useful):
  - type: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore, perf, ci, build
  - scope (only if the change is clearly scoped to one area):
    frontend, backend, api, db, infra, auth, ui, ci
- Examples: "feat", "fix,backend,api", "docs", "refactor,frontend",
  "chore,ci", "test,backend"
- If the change is purely a test, label "test"
- If unsure, use "chore"

OUTPUT RULES:
- Output ONLY the three blocks above in order: TITLE, description, LABELS
- No backticks, no markdown code fences, no explanations
- No "here is the description" or similar preamble
- A blank line between TITLE block and description bullets is required
- A blank line between description bullets and LABELS line is required
